policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: GPT‑Rosalind Academic Plan announced
items.summary: O introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible labs free sponsored seats and trusted-access enrollment for GPT‑Rosalind and Rosalind Workbench for life-sciences discovery.

items.headline: Multiple reentry spacecraft operations
items.summary: Space.com reports V operating two reentry vehicles in orbit after a joint Transporter-18 launch, with another launch expected “in the coming days” and seven more next year.

items.headline: GPT‑6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
items.summary: O announced broad availability of GPT‑6 along with an “Intelligent UI” experience, positioning it as a general release rather than limited access.

items.headline: Series A valuation recap (in last 45 days window)
items.summary: G’s previously announced financing valued the company at $3.5B and described scaling plans tied to moving from ~54MW to 200+MW in 2027.
